title: Desargues' theorem over free modules of rank 3 over non-commutative rings

problemStatement.formal: For a (possibly non-commutative) division ring D and triangles in P^2(D) = P(D^3), formalize the forward Desargues implication: perspective from a point (AA', BB', CC' concurrent) implies perspective from a line (P = AB' cap A'B, Q = BC' cap B'C, R = CA' cap C'A collinear), using rank-3 free left D-modules and a determinant-free (or Dieudonné-determinant) argument.
problemStatement.plain: The gallery already proves Desargues' theorem over any commutative ring using a polynomial determinant identity. This problem asks whether that can be pushed to non-commutative division rings (skew fields like the quaternions). Classically Desargues holds exactly in planes coordinatizable over a division ring, commutative or not, but the commutative determinant machinery breaks because non-commutative determinants are not multilinear or multiplicative.
whyMatters: Non-commutative Desargues is the sharp half of the Hilbert/Artin characterization of Desarguesian planes, and the regime where Desargues holds while Pappus fails.
It forces a genuinely non-commutative linear-algebra toolkit (Dieudonné determinant or synthetic collineations), laying groundwork for skew projective geometry in Lean.

proven: Desargues over any commutative ring K, forward and converse, fully verified in the gallery (desargues-theorem-oq-01, 0 sorries, 0 axioms).
Hilbert (1899): a projective plane is Desarguesian iff coordinatizable by a division ring (commutative or not).
Artin, Geometric Algebra (1957): coordinatization of P^n(D) over division rings and the Desargues/Pappus relationship.
Dieudonné (1943): a well-defined determinant for matrices over a non-commutative division ring.
open: No Lean formalization of P^2(D) or Desargues over a non-commutative division ring exists in the gallery or Mathlib.
Which route is most tractable in Lean: Dieudonné-determinant identity, synthetic central-collineation argument, or direct noncomm_ring component computation.
Whether the converse (perspective from a line implies from a point) extends with a suitable non-degeneracy hypothesis.
knownResults.goal: Formalize the forward direction desargues_forward_D over a general division ring D on rank-3 free left modules, 0 sorries, specializing back to the commutative result when D is a Field. Converse and counterexamples are out of scope for the first milestone.
